title: Attribution Strategies and Return on Keyword Investment in Paid Search Advertising
authors: H. Alice Li; P.K. Kannan; Siva Viswanathan; Abhishek Pani
eligible_reason: Single firm switches all keywords from last-click to first-click attribution on one common date (2012-05-02); estimated as a 3SLS simultaneous-equations system with First_touch as a regressor. No untreated comparison units, no staggered adoption, no TWFE DiD.
design_notes: Code.docx: systemfit 3SLS over 5 equations (revenue, log CPC, log position, CTR, conversion) with First_touch, first_spec (First_touch x specificity), log(Budget), lagged RPC, Valentine/Mother's Day dummies; instruments First_touch+spec+... Sample data: First_touch = 0 for 2012-01-21..2012-05-01 and 1 for 2012-05-02..2012-07-18 for every keyword (later first dates only reflect keyword entry). Interrupted time series / before-after quasi-experiment.
data_files_note: Shipped file is a 'sample data' extract: 1,058 rows for 8 keywords vs. several hundred keywords in the paper; no stated random sampling rule.
data_provenance_note: Small illustrative extract of proprietary retailer paid-search data with no stated random sampling rule (5b: counts as not_shipped).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; screened from README, code, sample data and OpenAlex abstract. Single common treatment date with no control group; out of scope regardless of text.
